current.text: He is a bench guard behind Cade Cunningham. The projected bench order is Isaiah Joe as sixth man, then Ron Holland, Paul Reed and Jenkins.
Over the final 16 games of last season, with Cunningham out, he played 31 minutes a night.
He has the best category upside on Detroit's bench and is draftable in 16-team leagues.
He is a late-round flyer only if he gets a bigger role, about 26 minutes or a starting job. Experts do not expect that unless Bickerstaff changes the rotation or Cunningham gets hurt.
Tobias Harris is gone, and Detroit has very few creators besides Cunningham.
Detroit may need another ball handler like Jenkins, which could open a bigger role for him.
Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation last season, which limited everyone's minutes.
Detroit's playoff schedule is 4-3-4 games in weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risks are expected.

note: Do not draft him in our 12-team league. His Yahoo rank is 193 with a value of 0 USD, he was not drafted last season, and experts only call him draftable in 16-team leagues. Last season he shot 40.8% on 7.9 attempts and averaged 3.9 assists in 20 minutes, so in a bench role he gives you assists and little else. Early in the season, check whether Bickerstaff gives him 26 or more minutes. If Cunningham gets hurt, pick him up right away: he played 31 minutes a night the last time Cunningham was out.
